title: Quick Melted Syrian Cheese Grill
description: A smoky and gooey Syrian dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, perfect for a quick and energizing snack.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the pita bread slices with olive oil on both sides.
Grill the pita bread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Place a slice of grilled pita bread on a flat surface and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese mixture on half of the bread.
Fold the bread in half to enclose the cheese.
Place the sandwich on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Cut the sandwiches in half and garnish with chopped parsley.
